_readme: CaseFacts for the M4-T7 demo case. The eight fields under _fromDocument are what dishonour-memo.pdf extracts (confidence ~0.9+, each with a sourceQuote from the memo); everything else is human-only and must be entered on the confirmation screen — the six status fields plus the three affidavit-boundary fields (LEGAL_RULES.md §2/§7). bankInfoReceivedDate is deliberately left null here to reproduce DEMO.md's 'correct a field' beat: the confirmation screen falls back to dishonourMemoDate (2026-07-24) with an on-screen assumption notice, computing a still-DEADLINE_MISSED-but-wrong noticeDeadline of 2026-08-23; entering the real 2026-08-06 (the trader was told about the bounce ~13 days after the bank generated the memo, not on the memo date itself) recomputes it to 2026-09-05 without changing the overall verdict. Verified with packages/rules' computeClockBoard for today in 2026-09-19..2026-09-22 (a few days' recording-slip buffer): overallStatus DEADLINE_MISSED, clock1 PASS (cheque valid for presentation until 2026-10-02), clock2 DEADLINE_MISSED with a RE_PRESENT_CHEQUE recoveryPath gated on that same 2026-10-02 date, both before and after the bankInfoReceivedDate correction.
